Bootstrap 5.3.3 — vendored CSS distribution
===========================================

File:   bootstrap.min.css
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css
        (upstream: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/releases/tag/v5.3.3)
Bytes:  232803
SHA256: 3c8f27e6009ccfd710a905e6dcf12d0ee3c6f2ac7da05b0572d3e0d12e736fc8

Vendored instead of linked from a CDN on purpose: the panel is a home-LAN /
localhost tool that must render with zero external requests (see
UI_UX_PLAN.md §6.3). Only the CSS is vendored — no JS bundle. The redesign
replaces modals/tooltips with native <dialog> and <details>, so
bootstrap.bundle.js is not needed.

License: MIT (Copyright 2011-2024 The Bootstrap Authors). The unmodified
upstream license banner is preserved at the top of bootstrap.min.css.

Do not edit bootstrap.min.css by hand; replace it wholesale when bumping the
pinned version and update the SHA256 above.
